supports: The Florida Dining Menu features a pasta section including lasagne
Lasagne is pasta layered with Bolognese meat sauce, ricotta, mozzarella and Romano cheese
Spaghetti is served with meatballs or Italian sausage
Pizza is made with Caputo flour, hand-stretched on semolina flour
Gluten free pasta is available as a substitute

editorial.hook: Italian kitchen with lasagne, spaghetti and hand-stretched pizza
editorial.why_here: Mandola's Italian Kitchen's Florida menu centers on pasta including lasagne and spaghetti with meatballs or Italian sausage, plus pizza made with Caputo flour and hand-stretched on semolina flour.
